title: Concept: pnpm lockfile records a resolution as a tarball URL only
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm resolution that records a tarball URL with no integrity value, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Nothing in the lockfile ties the fetched archive to a digest, so a mirror or proxy can serve different bytes for the same file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: Nothing in the lockfile ties the fetched archive to a digest, so a mirror or proxy can serve different bytes for the same file.
